recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reopen with FHIR-I only if the work group wants to revisit Resource.id expectations generally; do not reapply the exact FHIR-23741 wording over the newer create, conditional update, operation, and non-RESTful guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-23741 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to clarify the Resource.id comment so the old statement that a resource only lacks an id during create is limited to RESTful systems.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-23741 was found. The old absolute sentence entered the R5 source rework, FHIR-20651 changed it to a looser create/conditional-update comment, and FHIR-27052 changed the active Resource.id comment to the current RESTful-interactions wording.
additional_context: FHIR-27052 directly refined the same Resource.id comment for operations and non-RESTful use cases; FHIR-42909 later added a detailed list of cases where ids are typically absent to source/resource/resource-notes.xml; FHIR-28587 was retracted/Resolved-No-Change after discussion clarified that some facade behavior is ugly but conformant. The FHIR-I minutes and Zulip thread support the seed rationale and reveal no conflicting later decision requiring a narrower edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already implements the seed clarification and later accepted refinements, so replacing it with the exact 2019 proposed sentence would lose important later guidance.
